description: Implementation of the CustomerFacade interface, providing business logic for customer operations such as registration, retrieval, address updates, and cart merging within an e-commerce system. Uses Spring framework annotations and services.

classes.name: CustomerFacadeImpl
classes.description: Spring service implementing customer-related business logic, including registration, retrieval, merging shopping carts, and address updates.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer data by username and converts it into a CustomerEntity object.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges the customer's cart with a session cart, handling various scenarios for cart assignment and merging.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves customer information based on username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks whether a username already exists for a given store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer based on provided data, persisting it and returning a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Builds a Customer model object from PersistableCustomer data.

methods.name: customerEntityPoulator
methods.description: Converts a Customer object into a CustomerEntity object.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties for a Customer model, such as username, password, and groups.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication of a customer with provided username and password.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves billing or delivery address for a customer.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates billing or delivery address for a customer.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves a customer's data by ID and converts it into a ReadableCustomer.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Fills a Customer model object with data from PersistableCustomer.
